title: 英特尔回报路径清晰：谷歌可见度低，AI硬件分化将如何影响配置？
speaker: Stephanie Lung

segments.en: Stephanie Rebecca here, I just want to pick up on the point that Dave was making, kind of that short term versus longer term view. When we think about these shifts here, you mentioned that pullback that we've seen in AI hardware, some of that rotation elsewhere, healthcare, and so on. I'm just trying to get a sense. Do you see that as a durable shift? Or is this a moment, a transient moment of profit taking?
segments.zh: 我想接着Dave的话题，关于短期与长期视角。你提到AI硬件回调，资金轮动到医疗等其他板块。这是持久转变还是暂时的获利了结？

segments.en: Yeah, so if we look at what's going to ultimately drive long-term returns, I mean, it's obviously earnings growth. And still, I mean, where you find the best earnings growth is within the AI kind of value chain. Now, of course, at different times, different by parts of the AI value chain offers you most visibility in terms of return on investment. Right now, it's still hardware.
segments.zh: 长期回报最终由盈利增长驱动。目前盈利增长最好的地方仍在AI价值链中。当然，不同时期AI价值链的不同部分投资回报可见度不同。目前仍是硬件。

segments.en: And I think last night's earnings actually clearly shown that, for example, Intel has a very, very clear kind of path to seeing returns, whereas hyper-scalers like Google has a low visibility. So I still think that that remains kind of the core of the overall kind of bull market. But of course, you see kind of bolts of volatile periods right now we're in one and investors naturally rotate into other saver sectors or sectors that kind of are in favor.
segments.zh: 昨晚的财报清楚显示，英特尔有非常明确的回报路径，而谷歌等超大规模企业可见度较低。所以我仍认为这是整体牛市的核心。但当前处于波动期，投资者自然会轮动到更安全的板块。

segments.en: But I think over long-term, basically, if you look at fundamental, that's still very strong. US economy is still growing very strongly. Of course, we have a slight inflation problem. But it is through these times when you are in inflationary growth where equities tend to perform quite well. But as investors, actually, we don't have to think about the short term necessarily.
segments.zh: 但长期基本面依然强劲。美国经济仍在强劲增长，当然有轻微通胀问题。但在通胀性增长时期，权益资产往往表现不错。投资者其实不必过于关注短期。

segments.en: And we've actually done quite a bit of work on regular investing recently that compares quite favorably with the market timer, which I'm happy to kind of talk about more. Yeah, I want to pick up on that. I know you've done a lot of this research into sort of dollar cost averaging. And essentially, when is the right moment for the investor to lean in to just talk us through your thesis there and what you've found?
segments.zh: 我们最近做了不少关于定期投入的研究，结果优于择时交易。我很乐意多谈谈。我知道你们做了很多关于定投的研究，投资者何时应该加大投入？请讲讲你的观点和发现。
